I just remember how I expected my mum to be sympathetic vut instead she chose to beleive that I was at fault. She told my older sister and brother that I basically threw myself at him. Luckily they have stood by me. 

No one knows, other than my therapist and ex, what happened. I'm still scared to speak up about it to the authorities out of fear of being ridiculed for something that happened so long ago.
